definition: textual.app.App -> uos_tui/app.App (Homomorphic). class with compose() becomes a record of init/update/screens; reactivity is TEA re-render
textual.screen.Screen -> uos_tui/app.Screen (Isomorphic). named view over the model; push/pop via PushScreen/PopScreen effects
textual.widget.Widget -> uos_tui/widget.Widget(msg) (Homomorphic). class hierarchy becomes one closed sum type; state lives in the model
textual.dom.DOMNode -> uos_tui/widget.flatten/find/children (Isomorphic). pre-order tree with ids
Widget.compose -> uos_tui/app.Screen.view (Isomorphic). pure function model -> tree
textual.css -> uos_tui/style.Style (Reinterpreted). no CSS parser; typed style records with a combine monoid
textual.css.scalar -> uos_tui/layout.Scalar (Isomorphic). Cells, Fraction, Percent, Auto
textual.layouts -> uos_tui/layout.arrange/grid (Isomorphic). same resolution order: fixed, percent, auto, fraction
textual.geometry -> uos_tui/geometry.Region (Isomorphic). half-open rectangles with intersection/union laws
rich.segment / textual.strip -> uos_tui/segment.Strip (Isomorphic). styled runs with cached cell length; crop/extend/simplify
textual._compositor -> uos_tui/render.compose/arrange (Homomorphic). placements blitted into a frame; no dirty-region diffing yet
textual.reactive -> uos_tui/app.update -> render (Reinterpreted). every message re-renders; watchers become update clauses
textual.message / textual.events -> uos_tui/event.Event, msg (Homomorphic). system events typed; widget messages are user-typed msg
textual.binding.Binding -> uos_tui/widget.Binding(msg) (Isomorphic). key -> msg with description shown in Footer
textual.screen.focus_chain -> uos_tui/app.move_focus (Isomorphic). document-order Tab/Shift-Tab
textual.worker -> uos_tui/app + uos_tui/live.Effect.Task (Homomorphic). task functions run in BEAM processes by the live driver
textual.driver -> uos_tui/live.run/child_spec (Homomorphic). OTP actor + reader process; raw mode via pure Erlang shell API
textual.pilot.Pilot -> uos_tui/headless.run (Isomorphic). scripted events, captured frames
textual.command -> uos_tui/gallery.view/search/score (Homomorphic). fuzzy subsequence scoring; caller supplies the registry (uos_tui/gallery demos it)
textual.theme -> uos_tui/render.Theme (Homomorphic). single dark theme plus Dark Cockpit mode overlay
textual.widgets -> uos_tui/widget.Header, Footer (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.Static -> uos_tui/widget.Static (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.Button -> uos_tui/widget.Button (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.Input -> uos_tui/widget.Input (Homomorphic). no validators/suggester
textual.widgets.DataTable -> uos_tui/widget.DataTable (Homomorphic). row cursor only
textual.widgets.Tree -> uos_tui/widget.Tree (Homomorphic).
textual.widgets.ListView -> uos_tui/widget.ListView (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.ProgressBar -> uos_tui/widget.ProgressBar (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.Sparkline -> uos_tui/widget.Sparkline (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.Tabs -> uos_tui/widget.Tabs (Homomorphic). content switching is the model's job
textual.widgets.Log -> uos_tui/widget.Log (Homomorphic). plain lines, scroll offset
textual.widgets.Rule -> uos_tui/widget.Rule (Isomorphic).
textual.widgets.Collapsible -> uos_tui/widget.Checklist (Reinterpreted). UOS 5-domain/18-item checklist accordion (SC-CHECKLIST-001)
textual.containers -> uos_tui/widget.Container, Grid (Isomorphic). border + title like Textual border-title
(none) -> uos_tui/aspects.audit (Reinterpreted). UOS-only: fail-closed structural verification of a composed screen
(none) -> uos_tui/fprime.component/dictionary_json (Reinterpreted). UOS-only: ports, commands, channels, events, parameters, ground dictionary
textual-serve -> uos_tui/frame.to_text/to_ansi (Deferred). projection to Wisp at :4100 is a follow-on
(none) -> uos_tui/ontology.Fidelity (Reinterpreted). fidelity ladder Deferred -> Reinterpreted -> Homomorphic -> Isomorphic

The fourfold inner instrument of cognition; maps onto the agent's cognitive stack end to end.
Manas gathers and filters sense-data; maps onto the OODA Observe phase.

Citta is the substrate that retains impressions; maps onto the agent's ETS live memory table.
The four accepted means of valid cognition; maps onto the system's evidence sources for two-key verification.
Direct perception; maps onto observed runtime behaviour, the first key of two-key verification.

The five fluctuations of mind-stuff (Yoga Sūtra 1.6); maps onto the agent's cognitive/memory states.
Valid cognition grounded in perception/inference/testimony; maps onto a verified, Pass-admitted evidence state.
False cognition; maps onto a Fail verdict.
Cognition built from words/imagination without a directly grounded object; maps onto the dream module's speculative output posted as a Hypothesize.
The vṛtti of contentless sleep; maps onto an agent's Idle lifecycle line.
Retention of past experience; maps onto the ETS live table and the episodic memory namespace.
The five sheaths from gross to subtle; maps onto the system's layers from hardware to admitted harmony.
The gross material sheath; maps onto the hardware substrate and the BEAM VM it runs on.
The sheath of vital energy; maps onto running BEAM processes and the OTP supervisor.
The sheath of mind; maps onto the agents themselves and their OODA loops.
The sheath of discerning knowledge; maps onto formal verification and the 17-aspect audit.
The innermost sheath of bliss/harmony; maps onto the final `admitted` evidence state where discovered -> ... -> admitted closes without residue.
